# Felipe Vasconcelos

> Senior Software Engineer & Frontend Chapter Lead at adidas. Building micro-frontend platforms, AI-powered developer tools, and cloud-native systems. Based in Zaragoza, Spain. Originally from Recife, Brazil.

Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years building full-stack products across mobile, web, and cloud. I lead a team of 3 engineers, co-lead the Frontend Chapter, and own the architecture of a micro-frontend platform used across multiple product teams. I build custom AI integrations using MCP tooling that connects engineering systems and accelerates delivery. Born in Recife, Brazil, I bring that same energy to engineering: consistent, persistent, and always aligned with the team.

## Experience

### adidas — Senior Software Engineer · Frontend Chapter Lead (Jun 2019 to Present, Zaragoza, Spain)

**Leadership**

- Co-lead the Frontend Chapter as 1 of 3 technical leads, setting architecture standards across the micro-frontend platform

**AI Integration & Tooling**
- Built a custom MCP toolchain integrating Instana, Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence, and GitHub to enable AI-assisted engineering workflows
- Ran a one-month AI-accelerated delivery experiment combining GitHub Copilot, Figma AI, and custom MCP tooling
- Building an MCP server that indexes multiple repositories into a single queryable knowledge base for AI agents across the department

**Platform Engineering**
- Led legacy system rewrite delivered in 2 months against a 1-year estimate, integrating AI tooling across all engineering disciplines
- Designed AWS real-time notification system (CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway) serving ~3,000 concurrent users
- Migrated micro-frontend shell from Webpack to Vite; rewrote Jenkins shared library pipelines in Groovy for cross-team reuse
- Led Jest to Vitest migration — achieved 40%+ faster CI execution, benchmarked with Hyperfine across multiple environments

### Stellar Fusion — Full-Stack Engineer (Contract) (Jun 2021 to Jul 2022, Remote)

- Built an Excel-inspired formula evaluation engine running isomorphically in browser and backend

### CESAR · Samsung · Motorola — Software Engineer to Technical Lead (Dec 2010 to May 2019, Recife, Brazil)
